title: Phase-B recon-check (read-only): reproduce stage_level R + resolve AOI-yaw location
method: Pristine markers -> scale-bar MAD outlier reject -> vetted-6 LS plane (pure-python Jacobi eigensolver) -> R: normal->+Z (Rodrigues). Diff vs stored edr_t3_relevel.psx (level-only) and edr_t3_relevel_final.psx (level+frame). No save; in-memory only.

level_reproduction.verdict: NON-STRUCTURAL. Vetted set exact; normal matches diagnosis to ~0.2 deg; R reproduces the stored leveling-only transform to 0.23 deg, residual on the under-constrained cross DOF the diagnosis flags as low-precision (0.85m marker-Y-spread). Sub-degree, same method, same axis -> proceed.

yaw_location_RESOLVED.finding: relevel_final.transform = level(R) + ~2.06 deg rotation about world -Z ~= the -2.03 deg footprint yaw. The AOI YAW IS BAKED INTO chunk.transform (about world Z), not only region.rot. region is the 10x1x5 m box (both stored regions = exactly 10.0 x 1.0 x 5.0 m).
yaw_location_RESOLVED.design_consequence: stage_aoi: (1) footprint PCA -> yaw; (2) apply yaw rotation about world Z to chunk.transform; (3) set region center=centroid, size=10x1x5; (4) crop. Orientation assertion #7 checks marker 20 lands on +X half of the final frame.

phase_c_bar_implication: codified==manual max_abs_diff will be ~mm (cross-DOF level residual), NOT sub-mm/bit. Per the reframe this is corroboration-level (PASS-track), not structural. Real bar = determinism (codified==codified) + gate-vs-P13HMEON.
open_implementation_decision: Dense PointCloud API (MS 2.3.1) exposes NO per-point coord iterator and NO numpy in-process -> the 'all-points 2x2 covariance' footprint isn't directly implementable in stage_aoi. Options: (A) ortho-render footprint (all points contribute) -> PCA occupied cells, in-process, resolution pinned to DSM 0.01m; (B) export dense PLY -> .venv numpy 2x2 covariance, true all-points parameter-free but subprocess+~300MB temp/run.
